result.Method of Attack: Malicious npm packages impersonate legitimate Hardhat plugins to steal private keys, mnemonics, and configuration files; exploit Hardhat runtime environment functions hreInit() and hreConfig() to collect sensitive data; encrypt data with AES and exfiltrate to attacker-controlled endpoints using hardcoded keys and Ethereum addresses
result.Impacted Systems: Nomic Foundation, Hardhat development environment, associated plugins, production systems using Hardhat
result.Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via malicious npm packages impersonating legitimate Hardhat plugins
result.Indicators of Compromise: 20 malicious packages identified, most downloaded package @nomicsfoundation/sdk-test with 1,092 downloads, hardcoded keys and Ethereum addresses used for data exfiltration
